blocks.text: Yeh chapter 15 (Basic Separation Techniques) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is analytical chemistry? What must a complete chemical characterization of a compound include?
(Analytical chemistry kya hai? Kisi compound ki mukammal kimiyai pehchaan mein kya shaamil hona chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Analytical chemistry chemical characterization (kimiyai pehchaan) ki science hai. Mukammal pehchaan mein qualitative aur quantitative dono analyses shaamil hon.

book_ref.quote: Analytical chemistry is the science of chemical characterization.

blocks.prompt:
2 Differentiate between qualitative and quantitative analysis.
(Qualitative aur quantitative analysis mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Qualitative analysis batata hai kaun se elements hain; quantitative analysis batata hai kitne hain.

book_ref.quote: the chemist is concerned with the detection or identification of the elements present in a compound

rows: Compound mein maujood elements ki pehchaan.
Compound mein elements ki nisbati miqdaar maloom karna.
Sawal: kaun se elements maujood hain?
Sawal: har element kitna hai?

blocks.prompt:
3 Name the four major steps of a complete quantitative determination.
(Mukammal quantitative determination ke chaar bare steps ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Analysis ke liye sample lena. (2) Matloob juz (constituent) ko alag karna. (3) Measurement aur nataij ka hisaab. (4) Analysis se nateeja nikaalna.

book_ref.quote: A complete quantitative determination generally consists of four major steps

blocks.prompt:
4 Name the physical methods used to separate the components of a mixture.
(Mixture ke ajza alag karne ke physical methods ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Filtration, crystallization, simple distillation, fractional distillation aur paper chromatography.

book_ref.quote: The components of a mixture can be separated by any of the following physical methods.

blocks.prompt:
5 How is a mixture of common salt and sand separated by filtration?
(Namak aur rait ka mixture filtration se kaise alag kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mixture ko distilled paani mein daalein: namak hal ho kar solution banata hai, rait hal nahi hoti aur neeche baith jati hai. Filter karein: rait paper par residue, namak ka solution filtrate ban kar guzar jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The first step is to select a suitable solvent in which one of the components dissolves completely

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between a solute and a solvent with reference to a solution of common salt in water.
(Namak ke paani mein solution ke hawale se solute aur solvent mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Solute hal hone wala juz hai; solvent zyada miqdaar wala juz hai.

book_ref.quote: Common salt in this solution is called a solute while water is called a solvent.

rows: Woh juz jo hal hota hai, maslan namak.
Woh juz jis mein hal hota hai, maslan paani.
Kam miqdaar mein.
Solute ke muqable mein zyada miqdaar mein.

blocks.prompt:
7 What are the two most convenient ways of filtration? What decides the filter medium?
(Filtration ke do sab se aasaan tareeqe kaun se hain? Filter medium kis baat se tay hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Filter paper se ya filter crucible se filtration. Precipitate ki nauiyat aur doosri cheezein tay karti hain ke kaun sa filter medium ho.

book_ref.quote: The most convenient ways of filtration are either through a filter paper or through a filter crucible.

blocks.prompt:
8 How is the pore size and size of the filter paper chosen?
(Filter paper ka pore size aur size kaise chuna jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pore size precipitate ke zarraat ke size par munhasir hai. Paper itna bara ho ke aakhir mein chauthai se aadha precipitate se bhara ho.

book_ref.quote: Which pore size is to be used, depends upon the size of particles in the precipitate.

blocks.prompt:
9 How is a folded filter paper fitted into the funnel?
(Tah kiya filter paper funnel mein kaise lagaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tah kiya paper 60-degree funnel mein rakha jata hai, paani se geela kiya jata hai aur mazbooti se dabaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: moistened with water and firmly pressed down

blocks.prompt:
10 How is a fluted filter paper prepared?
(Fluted filter paper kaise tayyar kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam filter paper ko is tarah tah karte hain ke pankhe jaisi shakal bane jis mein baari baari ubhaar aur gehraiyan hon.

book_ref.quote: for preparation of such a paper ordinary filter paper in folded in such a way

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between filtrate and residue.
(Filtrate aur residue mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Filtrate filter se guzar jata hai; residue us par reh jata hai.

book_ref.quote: After filtration, the liquid which is obtained in the conical flask underneath the funnel is called the filtrate.

rows: Filtration ke baad funnel ke neeche flask mein aane wala liquid.
Filter paper par bachne wala solid.
Namak-rait mein: namak ka solution.
Namak-rait mein: rait.

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe the Gooch crucible and how it gives quick filtration.
(Gooch crucible bayan karein aur yeh tez filtration kaise karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gooch crucible porcelain ka hota hai, us ka surakhon wala pinda paper pulp ya naap ke filter paper se dhaanpa jata hai. Suction filtering apparatus mein rakhne se filtration tez hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Quick filtration can be done by placing such crucible in a suction filtering apparatus.

blocks.prompt:
13 How can a Gooch crucible be used to filter concentrated HCl or KMnO₄ solution?
(Gooch crucible se concentrated HCl ya KMnO₄ solution kaise filter kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh solutions paper se react karte hain. Gooch crucible ke surakh paper ki jagah asbestos mat se dhaanp dein to yeh filter ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: it may be used to filter solutions that react with paper e.g. concentrated HCl and KMnO₄ solutions

blocks.prompt:
14 What is a sintered glass crucible? Why is it convenient?
(Sintered glass crucible kya hai? Yeh aasaan kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh glass ka crucible hai jis ke pinde mein porous glass disc seal hoti hai. Yeh aasaan hai kyun ke Gooch crucible ki tarah tayyari nahi karni parti.

book_ref.quote: a glass crucible with a porous glass disc sealed into the bottom

blocks.prompt:
15 State the basic principle of crystallization.
(Crystallization ka bunyadi usool bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Solute zyada temperature par munasib solvent mein hal ho, aur solution thanda karne par zaid solute crystals ki shakal mein bahar aa jaye.

book_ref.quote: The basic principle of crystallization is the fact that the solute should be soluble

blocks.prompt:
16 Why is the saturated solution filtered while hot during crystallization?
(Crystallization mein saturated solution garm haalat mein kyun filter kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Garm filtration se ghair-hal-pazeer impurities nikalti hain aur solute filter paper ya funnel ki nali mein waqt se pehle crystallize nahi hota. Zaroorat ho to hot water funnel istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This avoids the premature crystallization of the solute on the filter paper or in the funnel stem.

blocks.prompt:
17 Why is the hot filtered solution cooled at a moderate rate?
(Garm filter shuda solution darmiyani raftaar se kyun thanda kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Darmiyani raftaar se thanda karne se khaalis substance ke darmiyane size ke crystals bante hain.

book_ref.quote: The hot filtered solution is then cooled at a moderate rate

blocks.prompt:
18 How are coloured or resinous impurities removed during crystallization?
(Crystallization mein rangdaar ya resinous impurities kaise nikali jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Crude substance ko solvent mein kaafi bareek pisa animal charcoal daal kar ubaala aur garm filter kiya jata hai. Charcoal rangdaar impurities adsorb kar leta hai; thanda hone par saaf substance filtrate se crystallize hota hai.

book_ref.quote: finely powdered animal charcoal and then filtering the hot solution

blocks.prompt:
19 When may crystals be dried in an oven?
(Crystals oven mein kab sukhaaye ja sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Crystals hawa mein ya oven mein sukhaaye ja sakte hain; oven tabhi jab substance 100 °C par na pighle na toote (decompose ho).

book_ref.quote: The crystals may be air-dried are dried in an oven.

blocks.prompt:
20 How are crystals dried in a vacuum desiccator? Name the drying agents used.
(Vacuum desiccator mein crystals kaise sukhaaye jate hain? Drying agents ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Crystals watch glass par phaila kar kayi ghante vacuum desiccator mein rakhe jate hain; yeh mehfooz aur qabil-e-aitbaar tareeqa hai. Drying agents: CaCl₂, silica gel ya phosphorus pentaoxide.

book_ref.quote: In this process the crystals are spread over a watch glass and kept in a vacuum desiccator for several hours.

blocks.prompt:
21 How should an ideal crystallization solvent behave towards the impurities and the solute?
(Achha crystallization solvent impurities aur solute ke saath kaisa bartaao kare?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh solute se kimiyai amal na kare. Ya to impurities hal na kare, ya impurities solute ke saath crystallize na hon. Thanda hone par khaalis compound ke achhe bane crystals de.

book_ref.quote: It should either not dissolve the impurities or the impurities should not crystallize from it along with the solute.

blocks.prompt:
22 What is the use of a hot water funnel in crystallization?
(Crystallization mein hot water funnel ka kya faida hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kabhi filtration ke dauran crystals ban kar filter paper ya funnel band kar dete hain. Hot water funnel is se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: During crystallization, sometimes the crystals start to appear during the process of filtration.

blocks.prompt:
23 Name the solvents mostly used for crystallization. What is done if none is suitable?
(Crystallization ke aam solvents ke naam likhein. Agar koi munasib na ho to kya karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paani, absolute ethanol, chloroform, carbon tetrachloride aur acetic acid. Koi munasib na ho to do ya zyada miscible solvents mila kar istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The solvents which are mostly used for crystallization are

blocks.prompt:
24 Why is a water bath used when the crystallization solvent is inflammable?
(Inflammable solvent ke saath water bath kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Inflammable (aag pakarne wala) solvent seedha garm karne par aag pakar sakta hai. Water bath par garm karna ehtiyaat hai.

book_ref.quote: If the solvent is inflammable, then precaution should be taken while heating the solution

blocks.prompt:
25 Why is sea water not drinkable? How is it made drinkable?
(Samandari paani peene ke qabil kyun nahi? Isay peene ke qabil kaise banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Samandari paani mein bohat se hal shuda inorganic compounds hain. Simple distillation se paani in compounds se alag kar ke peene ke qabil banaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: To get rid of these compounds, sea water is distilled to make it drinkable.

blocks.prompt:
26 Why are boiling chips added and why is the apparatus made air tight in simple distillation?
(Simple distillation mein boiling chips kyun daalte hain aur apparatus air tight kyun karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Boiling chips liquid ki bumping (jhatke se uchhalna) rokte hain. Apparatus air tight karte hain taake vapours bahar na niklein.

book_ref.quote: Add a few pieces of boiling chips to prevent bumping of the liquid in the flask.

blocks.prompt:
27 What is the role of the condenser in distillation?
(Distillation mein condenser ka kya kirdaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Condenser ke gird thanda paani ahista ghoomta hai. Guzarne wale vapours dobara liquid (distillate) ban kar receiving flask mein jama hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The water circulating around the condenser will condense these vapours back into the liquid form.

blocks.prompt:
28 Differentiate between distillate and residue in distillation.
(Distillation mein distillate aur residue mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Distillate condense ho kar jama hota hai; residue distillation flask mein rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: This is called distillate and it will be collected in the receiving flask.

rows: Receiving flask mein jama hone wala condensed liquid.
Distillation flask mein bache hue ajza.
Samandari paani mein: khaalis paani.
Samandari paani mein: hal shuda inorganic compounds.

blocks.prompt:
29 How is a mixture of ethyl alcohol and water separated by fractional distillation?
(Ethyl alcohol aur paani ka mixture fractional distillation se kaise alag hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethyl alcohol (b.p. 78 °C) pehle distil hota hai, thermometer 78 °C par rehta hai. Temperature 78 °C se upar jaye to receiving flask badal dete hain; 100 °C par paani ubal kar doosre distillate ki shakal mein jama hota hai.

book_ref.quote: As long as the alcohol is being distilled over, the temperature of the thermometer will remain at 78 °C.

blocks.prompt:
30 How are fuels obtained from petroleum?
(Petroleum se fuels kaise hasil kiye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Petroleum petrol, diesel, kerosene aur furnace oil jaise compounds ka mixture hai jin ke boiling points qareeb hain. Yeh fractionating column ke zariye fractional distillation se fractions ki shakal mein alag hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Petroleum in natural form is a mixture of many compounds which are commonly used as fuels.

blocks.prompt:
31 Define chromatography.
(Chromatography ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Chromatography mixture ke sample ko alag karne ka tareeqa hai. Is mein solute (mixture) stationary phase aur mobile phase ke darmiyan taqseem hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Chromatography is a method used primarily for the separation of a sample of mixture.

blocks.prompt:
32 Differentiate between the stationary phase and the mobile phase.
(Stationary phase aur mobile phase mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Stationary phase thehra rehta hai; mobile phase us par behta hai.

book_ref.quote: The stationary phase may be a solid or a liquid supported as a thin film on the surface of an inert solid.

rows: Apni jagah thehra rehta hai.
Stationary phase ki satah par behta hai.
Solid, ya inert solid par patli tah ki shakal mein liquid.
Gas ya liquid.

blocks.prompt:
33 What happens to a substance in adsorption chromatography? Give two examples.
(Adsorption chromatography mein substance ke saath kya hota hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Substance mobile phase chhor kar solid stationary phase ki satah par adsorb (chipak) jata hai. Misalein: TLC aur column chromatography.

book_ref.quote: In this type, a substance leaves the mobile phase to become adsorbed on the surface of the solid phase.

blocks.prompt:
34 Why is paper chromatography called partition chromatography?
(Paper chromatography ko partition chromatography kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka stationary phase liquid hai: paper ke cellulose fibres mein phansa paani. Mobile phase (aksar organic liquid) us se nahi milta, aur substances dono liquid phases mein taqseem hote hain.

book_ref.quote: It is a type of partition chromatography.

blocks.prompt:
35 Name the three ways of carrying out paper chromatography. How does the solvent move in the ascending type?
(Paper chromatography ke teen tareeqon ke naam likhein. Ascending mein solvent kaise chalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ascending, descending aur radial / circular. Ascending mein solvent capillary action se upar charhta hai.

book_ref.quote: There are three common ways of carrying out paper chromatography namely

blocks.prompt:
36 Why is the chromatographic tank kept covered?
(Chromatographic tank ko dhaanp kar kyun rakha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tank ko dhaanpa jata hai taake andar ki fiza (atmosphere) yaksaan rahe.

book_ref.quote: Cover the tank to homogenize its inner atmosphere.

blocks.prompt:
37 How is the sample applied to the chromatographic paper?
(Chromatographic paper par sample kaise lagaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Whatman paper No. 1 ki 20 cm patti par aik sire se 2.5 cm par patli pencil line lagate hain. Line par sample ka spot lagate hain, pehchaan ke liye saath maloom compounds ke spots bhi.

book_ref.quote: Spot a point, on the pencil line, with the sample mixture solution.

blocks.prompt:
38 How are the spots of colourless substances located on a chromatogram?
(Chromatogram par berang substances ke spots kaise dhoonde jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chromatogram ko UV lamp ki roshni mein dekh kar, jahan spots rangdaar nazar aate hain, ya ninhydrin jaisa locating agent laga kar.

book_ref.quote: If colourless, the chromatogram has to be developed by chemical methods or physical techniques

blocks.prompt:
39 What is a locating agent? Give an example.
(Locating agent kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Locating agent aisa chemical hai jo berang substances (maslan amino acids) se react kar ke dikhne wale rangdaar products banata hai. Misaal: ninhydrin.

book_ref.quote: A locating agent is generally a chemical that reacts with the colourless substances

blocks.prompt:
40 Define the retardation factor (Rf value).
(Retardation factor (Rf value) ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Har component ka khaas retardation factor hota hai:
Rf = asal spot se component ka faasla ÷ asal spot se solvent ka faasla.

book_ref.quote: Each component has a specific retardation factor

blocks.prompt:
41 In a chromatogram the solvent front is 7.5 cm from the base line; spot B is 2.4 cm and spot C is 5.1 cm from it. Find the Rf values of B and C.
(Chromatogram mein solvent front base line se 7.5 cm par hai; spot B 2.4 cm aur spot C 5.1 cm par. B aur C ki Rf values nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Each distance is measured from the base line

blocks.prompt:
42 A substance has Rf = 0.40 with a given paper and solvent. How far will its spot move when the solvent front travels 12.5 cm from the original spot?
(Aik substance ki Rf = 0.40 hai. Solvent front asal spot se 12.5 cm chale to spot kitna chalega?)
blocks.explanation: Substance ka faasla = Rf × solvent ka faasla = 0.40 × 12.5 cm = 5.0 cm.

book_ref.quote: The Rf value is always the same for a particular substance

blocks.prompt:
43 How is a paper chromatogram used to identify a substance?
(Paper chromatogram se kisi substance ki pehchaan kaise hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Substance ko maloom khaalis samples ke saath chalaate hain. Aik hi stationary aur mobile phase mein jin do substances ki Rf values barabar hon woh aik hi ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: A paper chromatogram can also be used to identify substances by comparing them with known samples

blocks.prompt:
44 What is Whatman's filter paper No. 1? State its properties.
(Whatman's filter paper No. 1 kya hai? Is ki khoobiyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh khaas chune hue cotton cellulose ka filter paper hai, aam paper chromatography mein istemal hota hai. Is ki retention aur flow rate darmiyani aur pore size 11 μm hai.

book_ref.quote: Whatman’s filter paper No. 1 is used for routine applications

blocks.prompt:
45 Give any two applications of chromatography.
(Chromatography ke koi do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Organic synthesis mein products ki alehdgi, isolation aur safai. (2) Dyes, drugs aur pesticides jaise pecheeda chemicals ki pehchaan. Qualitative/quantitative analysis aur purity ke liye bhi.

book_ref.quote: They are equally important in qualitative and quantitative analyses

blocks.text: 15.4 How to check the purity of the product

blocks.prompt:
46 How are liquids purified and how is their purity checked?
(Liquids kaise saaf kiye jate hain aur un ki purity kaise check hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Liquids aam tor par normal pressure ya vacuum mein distil kar ke saaf kiye jate hain. Purity un ke boiling points ko literature ki qeemat se mila kar check hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Liquids are generally purified by distilling them at normal pressure or under vacuum.

blocks.prompt:
47 How is crude aspirin obtained and purified after its preparation?
(Banane ke baad crude aspirin kaise hasil aur saaf ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aspirin salicylic acid aur zaid acetic anhydride se concentrated H₂SO₄ ki chand boondon ke saath banti hai. Paani daal kar precipitate karte hain, filter kar ke crude aspirin milti hai, phir paani (polar solvent) mein crystallize karte hain.

book_ref.quote: After the reaction is over, water is added in the reaction mixture to precipitate out aspirin.

blocks.prompt:
48 Differentiate between a pure and an impure sample of aspirin on the basis of melting point.
(Melting point ki bunyaad par khaalis aur na-khaalis aspirin mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Khaalis aspirin sharply pighalti hai; na-khaalis aik range mein.

book_ref.quote: To check whether the product is pure or impure, its melting point is determined.

rows: Theek 136 °C par sharply pighalti hai.
Melting point sharp nahi hota.
Aik hi temperature par pighalti hai.
Temperature ki aik range mein pighalti hai (maslan salicylic acid mili ho).

blocks.prompt:
49 What is the mixed melting point method of checking purity?
(Purity check karne ka mixed melting point tareeqa kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Product ko usi compound ke khaalis sample (maslan khaalis aspirin) se mila kar melting point naapte hain. Phir bhi sharp melting point ho to product khaalis hai.

book_ref.quote: Another way of assessing the purity of the product is to get the mixed melting point.
